votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of May 22, 2025; May 29, 2025; June 5, 2025; June 10, 2025; and August 19, 2025, as well as the Truth-in-Taxation meeting minutes of August 19, 2025.
votes.description: Formal approval of several prior work session meeting minutes and the Truth-in-Taxation meeting minutes from August 2025.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 31 of 2025 declaring the second Monday in October as Indigenous Peoples Day in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing Indigenous homelands, honoring cultural contributions, and promoting anti-discrimination efforts and native-led programs.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Resolution authorizing issuance and sale of Public Utilities revenue bond anticipation notes, Series 2025B, and revenue refunding bonds, Series 2025C.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a resolution to issue up to $50 million in bond anticipation notes to finance Public Utilities campus improvements and up to $50 million in refunding bonds to refinance outstanding 2017 bonds.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the resolution for the Substantial Amendment to the HOME-ARP Allocation Plan.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a resolution to reallocate $230,306 in HUD HOME-ARP funds from rental assistance to supportive/case management services.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 58 of 2025, Incentives for Building Preservation/Adaptive Reuse Zoning Text Amendment.
votes.description: Amends Title 21A of the Salt Lake City Code to expand administrative review options for building preservation and adaptive reuse, clarify design standards for new construction, and allow one-year time extensions of preliminary approval.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Partial Street Vacation at approximately 1101 West 400 South to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed ordinance to vacate a portion of public right-of-way adjacent to 1101 West 400 South and defers a final decision to a later meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 59 of 2025, Alley Vacation at 1470 East 1300 South.
votes.description: Vacates a portion of a City-owned alley between approximately 1430 East and 1500 East, between 1300 South and Sherman Avenue, which is obstructed and not used for access by abutting properties.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 60 of 2025, designating 276 East 300 South & 310 South 300 East as Local Landmark Sites.
votes.description: Establishes the Sampson and Altadena Apartments as a local landmark site, providing stronger historic preservation protections for the two buildings on one lot in Council District 4.

votes.motion: Postpone action on the Zoning Text Amendment and Street Vacation ordinances related to West High School to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: Delays Council action on proposed Public Lands zoning text amendments and street vacation at approximately 240 West 200 North (West High School) pending further stakeholder discussions.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 61 of 2025, Alley Vacation adjacent to 373 West American Ave and 389 West American Ave.
votes.description: Vacates a City-owned alley adjacent to properties at approximately 373 West and 389 West American Avenue to allow potential redevelopment by the adjacent property owners.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 62 of 2025, amending Salt Lake City Code sections 2.84.020 & 2.84.030 to allow for the modification of the capacity of the Salt Lake City Justice Court.
votes.description: Amends City Code to clarify the City's ability to expand the number of authorized judgeships in the Justice Court, subject to Judicial Council approval, to respond to growth in caseloads.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda, excluding Item #6.
votes.description: Approves multiple consent items including setting public hearing dates, board appointments (Cooper Fankhauser, Sean Weeks, Samantha DeSeelhorst to advisory boards), and other administrative matters, while excluding the appointment of Parviz Faiz.
